_comment: light_requirement:0 disables DynamicLeavesBlock.hasAdequateLight (default 13). Required because dtquark:azalea species declares this as its alt_leaves (35% place_chance) — without matching the base leaves' setting, the flowering variant would still decay/refuse to grow at skylight 0 inside lush_caves, leaving holes or damaged canopy on cave-grown azaleas. Mirrors the fix applied to azalea.json.
